title: CoTK: An Open-Source Toolkit for Fast Development and Fair Evaluation of Text Generation
reasoning: The paper presents a technical toolkit for evaluating text generation models. Its focus is on methodological rigor, such as consistent experimental settings and metric implementations. The term 'fair evaluation' refers to the technical comparability of results, not to social fairness, ethics, or bias. The paper does not contain any discussion related to religion, morals, or ethical frameworks.
